prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Staubstrasse", a dusty desert crossroads in the wasteland outside the cyberpunk city, seen from above. The whole image is open, flat, walkable rust-red and ochre sand ground with tyre tracks; a wide straight cracked asphalt desert road, half buried in drifting sand, runs horizontally through the middle of the image from the left edge to the right edge - this is the main walkable area. Right of center the road crosses two sandy dirt tracks (pistes), one going straight up to the top edge and one going straight down to the bottom edge; at the crossing stands a crooked signpost with many arrow boards (arrows and symbols only, no letters).
TOP LEFT: "the Wreck Castle" - a fortress built from stacked rusty car wrecks, bus shells and corrugated sheet metal forming thick walls around a square sandy courtyard; on top of the walls flutter black crow-feather pennants and rags on poles; in the courtyard a burning oil-barrel fire pit in the center, old sofas, tyres, motorcycle parts. The fortress has one big open gate in the middle of its south wall, made of two car doors and a hanging chain - facing the road.
Next to the gate on the road side: a small lookout post on stilts made of scrap with a hand-cranked siren.
TOP CENTER: on low dunes, a small water vendor's stall: a big dented water tank on a trailer with a tap, a patched sun umbrella, jerrycans stacked around it.
TOP CENTER between the stall and the north piste, in the far background on the dunes: three tall white wind turbines (some blades broken) and dry desert scrub.
TOP RIGHT: a dusty oval race track for wreck races, marked by tyre walls and oil barrels, a wooden jump ramp made of planks and a car hood on the right curve, a chequered start line (pattern only) near the road with a little scaffold tower.
BOTTOM CENTER-LEFT: "Rudi's Diner" - the most eye-catching spot: the long silver fuselage of a crashed old passenger airplane lying horizontally in the sand, converted into a roadside diner, round windows glowing warm yellow, a door with a few steps in the middle of its upper (north) side facing the road, above the door a big retro neon sign shaped like a pancake stack with wings (a symbol, no letters) glowing pink and turquoise, a stub of a wing sticking out into the sand, the tail fin at its right end with graffiti shapes on the back, a few plastic chairs and a sun awning by the door.
BOTTOM LEFT: a cluster of tall thin old metal radio masts and poles with hanging wind chimes and tin cans (the "singing masts"), half buried bottles in the sand at their feet.
LEFT EDGE on the road: a toll barrier made of a red-white painted pipe on a tyre stack, a shabby toll booth of scrap metal with crow feathers, sandbags.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a convoy stop - two big dusty armoured trucks / road trains with tarps and roof racks full of crates parked side by side, an awning between them with market crates; in front of them a ring of stones and logs around a campfire pit with a kettle.
RIGHT EDGE on the road: a small flat parking spot with a sand-covered rusty old station wagon car (half dismantled, roof rack) parked facing the city.
Small things at the edges: cacti, bleached cow-like skulls of robots, rusty barrels, tumbleweeds, car tyres, broken road signs (no letters), cables drawn thin.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP edge (north), right of center - the sandy piste leaves the image toward a distant ruined radio tower; BOTTOM edge (south), right of center - the sandy piste leaves the image toward a farm; LEFT edge (west) - the asphalt road leaves the image through the toll barrier into glittering haze of glass dust; RIGHT edge (east) - the parked old car on the road.
Light and material: wasteland in bright hot afternoon daylight, dusty orange and rust-red sand, long soft shadows, dry ground without puddles, heat haze; the city neon only as small accents on the diner sign and the toll booth.
